details.detail: Surface detail: value, panel tone, seams, fastener rows, slat band, gear stripe, placards, grime
details.note: This is the biggest gain of the round. The wing value is now right. Near skin L185 in w17K (was 161) against KN41 near skin L194. w26K wing/cloud-deck is 175/203 = 0.86 (was 0.76), so the wing is no longer darker than the deck. The photo grime layer reads as soft chordwise flow streaks with no visible tiling (rb9/zpanel.png, z19A). Residual tone SD on the w19A near flap is 5.4 % (r7 2.0 %) against KN41 4.8 %. The placards are now #baa0aa on #b6bdc4 (r-b +16, was +46) and barely register. Left over: (1) In w19A the near-far gradient still runs slightly the wrong way: near (620,500) L152 against far (620,250) L164, where KN41 has 194 -> 145. The b-r is +30 against +21 in KN41. (2) The 62 % rear-spar fastener row (4.0-11.3) follows the chord fraction and draws a bowed curve in c_wing_panel (400,262) -> (230,555). The 45 % splice is now straight (fixed).

The per-panel flat tones and sheen tilt now read as separate plates, as in KN41. In z19A and z26K the spoilers and flap panels step visibly against the fixed skin and against each other. The gap hierarchy is unchanged and correct: faint breaks, a dark spoiler TE and flap gap, and a dark aileron line. The breaks are continuous with no dashing.

The silhouette is now right. In c_canoe_side and z26K the top line falls to a near-pointed tip with no bulb or boot, matching _7345 and _7250. Two problems remain. (1) From the A side (w19A) every canoe shows only its dark flank: (470,350) #434953 L72 against skin L152, a ratio of 0.47. The lit top facet is a hairline. KN41 canoes carry a lit top at L131-155 (0.75 of the skin) over a shaded side at L82, and _7345 shows a canoe at 0.6 of the skin. They still read as charcoal shark teeth. (2) The single 0.7 cap section leaves a small downward hook/nub at the tip, visible as a dark dot in c_canoes_left at (410,297) and (783,377) (rb9/zcanoe_tip.png).
Unchanged. The forward fairing hump rises over the aft cowl (w13A top band, c_nacelle_left). In LALF _137 the fairing reads larger and more angular, with a darker flank.

details.detail: Nacelle geometry (cowl, lip, splits, strake, access panel)
details.note: Unchanged and good. The splits, the strake chine, the access panel and the lip proportions match LALF _136/_137.

Fixed after four rounds. The mark is now a ring with curled rim swashes around script 'G' and 'ε', with a small block 'GE' wordmark to its left (rb9/zge.png), which is the knav _9 layout. The swashes run as near-concentric arcs inside the ring, where the real monogram's swashes break out of the ring as four pointed curls. This shows only in the studio close-up.

Unchanged. The lip and the graded liner read correctly in w11A/w11K. In c_nacelle_left the fan is still a void with only a spinner nub. IQCFQpV_T1A, at a similar three-quarter angle, shows the blade ring and spinner clearly.

The strokes are now 0.23 m (16 % of the 1.4 m glyph height) at a 1.10 m pitch. The glyph rows in w17K separate better (rb9/z17K_reg.png against z17K_reg_r7.png). The remaining comb look is mostly honest perspective: from 17K the chordwise glyph height runs horizontally and the span is foreshortened, so every glyph stretches into horizontal strokes. The real stroke/height ratio is about 1/5 in _7250 (rb9/a7250_reg.jpg), so the weight is now right. Ink #1d2c56 on the brighter skin gives good contrast. In w26K/w30K the band still sits under the shade rail (camera).
In n19A the wing is now readable as a dark navy form, not near-black, and the red nav point sits at the tip. The discharger comb is visible in w19A and c_wing_panel.

There is no z-fighting at the registration, the placards, the gear stripe, the GE mark or the new panel-tone edges, and no gaps at the canoe/wing or pylon/wing joins. The grime layer shows no tiling or moiré. One small defect: the canoe-tip nub (see canoes).

issues.detail: canoe flank tone from the A side
issues.problem: From the A side (w19A) the canoes show only a charcoal flank at 0.47 of the skin luma, with a hairline lit top. In KN41 the canoes read as light pods: a lit top at 0.75 of the skin over a darker side. In _7345 the canoe is 0.6 of the skin. This is now the darkest element in the w19A frame apart from the stripe and the gaps, and it reads as a row of dark fins.
evidence: ref/web/exterior/a5_kn_ANA77W_TheRoom_41.jpg canoe top (860,330) #8c9db6 L155, side (940,600) L82, skin (600,560) L177
issues.fix: 11_exterior.js line 436 (canoe shadeVerts): flank 0.72 -> 0.86 and widen the lit facet: `lerp(lerp(0.86, 0.5, smooth(-0.3, -0.8, n[1])), 1, smooth(0.1, 0.4, n[1]))`. If the sun term still crushes the shaded flank, add a small flank lift only for |n.x| > 0.7 (x1.08).

issues.detail: wing near-far value gradient still reversed in w19A
issues.problem: The near inboard flap and skin render darker than the outboard skin (152 against 164). In every ANA photo the near skin is the brightest (KN41 194 -> 145, KN46 221 -> 207). The w19A wing keeps b-r +30, a grazing-sky blue cast, against +21 in KN41 under a deep blue sky. The gap-analysis albedo ramp was not implemented.
issues.fix: In the per-vertex wing loop (after setVert / before the `if (!mov) continue`), apply to every non-metal wing vertex: `const rp = lerp(1.07, 0.93, clamp((sp - 6) / 22, 0, 1)); for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) B.c[k * 4 + c] = Math.round(clamp(B.c[k * 4 + c] * rp, 0, 255));` and keep the movable-panel tint after it. Optionally drop the blue tint of the movable panels from [0.97, 0.985, 1.03] to [0.98, 0.99, 1.01].

issues.problem: The single cap section at u = 0.7 (0.16 x 0.09 of the section) closes the tip with a small down-turned nub that shows as a dark dot at the tip in c_canoes_left.
issues.fix: In the canoe loop, make the cap closer to a point: `secs.push(sec(x1 + 0.7 * RE, 0.10, 0.06), sec(x1 + 0.95 * RE, 0.03, 0.02))`, so the topAt fall continues through the cap and it does not drop below the last body section.

issues.problem: The 62 % chord rivet row (s 4.0-11.3) follows the chord fraction across the TE (Yehudi) break and draws a curved line in c_wing_panel. The real rear spar is straight.
issues.fix: Do as for the splice: for fc 0.62 use a straight line between xa(4.0) and xa(11.3), `spanPath(a, b, (q) => lerp(xa(a), xa(b), (q - a) / (b - a)), n)`.

issues.problem: The four swashes curl inward as near-concentric arcs inside the ring. The real GE monogram's swashes break outward through the ring as pointed curls. This is visible only in the studio close-up.
issues.fix: In the swash generator, make r grow past the ring at the start: `r = 0.27 - 0.13 * t` (from 0.24 * (1 - 0.42 * t)), and taper the tube for j < 2 (not possible with gTube: shorten the first segment instead).

issues.problem: The s13A underwing is saturated royal blue. In w26K/w30K the registration and the outboard canoes sit just under the shade bottom rail.
issues.fix: Lighting: desaturate the sunset sky bounce on downward-facing exterior normals. Camera: pitch 26K/30K lookOut down about 3 degrees.
